fields.summary_ko.0: iM Securities initiated new coverage on Samsung Electronics with a target price of KRW 370,000 and a Buy rating, expecting ROE of 56%, 59%, and 48% for 2026–2028 respectively, maintaining plateau-level profit generation capability compared to the 25-year historical average of 22%.
fields.summary_ko.1: The target price based on 2028 BPS could be raised to a maximum of KRW 560,000, with market confidence in earnings sustainability and cHBM re-evaluation as conditions for stock recovery.
